question: Can a fixed causal interval mean of delivered phase pressures improve full-run control beyond instantaneous pressure, an equal-span pure lag and the existing mixed-sensing pressure reference?
rationale: The two-second span equals the existing decision interval, not a tuned optimum. Mean uses the current delivered pressure and previous 20 ticks: 21 samples spanning 2.0 s. Compute existing clipped movement/phase pressure before averaging. Exact integer sums share a divisor, so argmax uses no floating-point rounding. Lag selects the frame delivered 20 ticks earlier. This lag is a declared strong control motivated by consumed observations, not an independent discovery.
startup: Use the available causal buffer for the mean; retain explicit missing-frame counts and the existing zero-count missing delivery. Lag uses zero scores until its 21-frame buffer is full. Initial startup ends before physical switching eligibility; no clean replacement or future frame is used.
mechanics: Five methods in both starts repeated twice (20 x 800 ticks), ten independent 400-tick prefix replays, and six 800-tick old-runtime anchors: clean instantaneous, mixed instantaneous and pure-lag vs an added-delay sensor, in both starts. Total 36 native jobs / 24,800 samples. Require >=1 same-state current-versus-mean proposal difference on each mean arm; no smoke performance selection.
analysis: Primary 360 s; overlapping secondary 180 s. Average starts within each traffic seed. Equal-seed means and exact 64-draw family-stratified descriptive bootstrap, two seeds per family. Preserve every context, seed, family and start-group result. Seven predeclared contrasts include the full history-by-sensing interaction. No multiplicity-adjusted population inference.
continuation: The primary mean_clean must gain >=2% mean waiting against all three fixed references, with no aggregate p95/throughput or start-group mean loss and no seed >1% worse. mean_mixed must have no aggregate mean/p95/throughput or start-group mean loss and no seed >1% worse against instant_mixed. All jobs and signal/observation audits must complete. Failure closes this exact interval-mean recipe without window/endpoint/arm search. Passing permits bounded classical development only; no automatic training, controller promotion, novelty or publication readiness.

novelty: Moving averages and pressure control are established. This is an explicitly attributed engineering baseline and controlled empirical test, not a newly invented optimal controller. No MATLAB code or traffic-paper implementation is copied.
limits: Known Bernoulli demand families, new realizations, straight-only SUMO topology, synthetic delay/misses, deterministic driving and empty starts. No camera calibration, independent-family final test, learned-model improvement or network stability guarantee.
restart_contract: At most four sessions with a cooperative 900 s full cap (3,600 s declared collection allowance). Verification/preparation outside session timers. Atomic immutable episode records; resume skips only the validated exact completed prefix. Unknown hard-kill times remain unknown. Only declared budget or planned smoke pause auto-continues; Ctrl+C requires explicit later --resume. Integrity/runtime failures block continuation.
